node: Grid construction labor, lineworker availability, and installation automation
summary: This pass expands the universe around grid construction labor scarcity and installation productivity. The strongest underfollowed fit is PLPC because it is a small-cap transmission/distribution hardware supplier with a disclosed robotic overhead-line spacer installation system developed with FulcrumAir. Terex is a second-order productivity-enabler candidate through utility aerial devices and digger derricks used in overhead electric-line construction and maintenance. MYRG is included as a reference contractor exposed to the labor bottleneck rather than an obscure tool supplier. Hubbell is a large-cap reference/competitor anchor for utility T&D components, useful for mapping PLPC's relative purity but less aligned with the underfollowed lane.
